Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: A couple of weeks before the semester starts, the course registration opened up. It's a good idea to take a look at the courses beforehand.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There was a group chat where students could ask questions.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Succesful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: If the course you want isn't "available" to you, don't be afraid to write an email to ask if it's possible to register anyways. Also if you run into any problems the international office is also helpful
